## Load and build dataframe (Data from Matlab [Plotting_ERP.m])
```{r}
data <- read_excel("Data_ERP_results_CorrectTrials-StimLock_FCz_250728.xlsx") 
Stimulation <- factor(data$Stimulation, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC"))
Subject <- factor(data$Subjects)
Time <- data$TimePoint
Congruence <- factor(data$CorrectCongIncong, levels = c(1,-1), labels = c("Congruent", "Incongruent"))
ERP <- data$ERP

df <- data.frame(Subject,Time,Stimulation,ERP,Congruence)
df$Stimulation <- relevel(df$Stimulation,"aMCC")


```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Time, y = ERP, color = Stimulation, linetype = Congruence, fill = Stimulation)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 350, xmax = 450, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.1, fill = "gray") +
  
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.2,
               aes(group = interaction(Stimulation, Congruence)), color = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1,
               aes(group = interaction(Stimulation, Congruence))) +
  labs(title = "ERP Curves with SEM",
       y = "ERP (μV)", x = "Time (ms)") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed", "solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",  # reddish purple
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",  # orange/yellow
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"   # sky blue
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(25, -10)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 18)
  )
```

#Compute N2 peak 

```{r}

# Subset time window for N2 (350-450 ms), Correct trials only
df_window <- df %>%
  filter(Time >= 350 & Time <= 450)

# For each subject and stimulation, find the peak (most negative ERP value)
# Then extract values within ±20ms around that peak
df_n2_peaks <- df_window %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation) %>%
  mutate(
    peak_time = Time[which.min(ERP)],      # time of most negative value
    peak_amplitude = min(ERP, na.rm = TRUE) # the peak value itself
  ) %>%
 # filter(Time >= peak_time - 20 & Time <= peak_time + 20) %>%
  mutate(times_used = list(sort(unique(Time)))) %>%  # save times used for the window
  summarise(
    N2           = mean(ERP, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_time     = first(peak_time),
    peak_amplitude = first(peak_amplitude),
    times_used    = list(first(times_used)),   # one list per subject×stimulation
    .groups = 'drop'
  )


```


```{r}
# Convert factors
df_n2_peaks$Subject <- as.factor(df_n2_peaks$Subject)
df_n2_peaks$Stimulation <- as.factor(df_n2_peaks$Stimulation)

# Run repeated measures ANOVA
anova_results <- ezANOVA(
  data = df_n2_peaks,
  dv = N2,
  wid = Subject,
  within = .(Stimulation),
  detailed = TRUE
)

print(anova_results)
```


# Beta regressor of CONGRUENCE

```{r}
# ── Unnest times_used from df_n2_peaks into long format ──────────────────────
df_times_long <- df_n2_peaks %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Stimulation, peak_time, times_used) %>%
  unnest(times_used) %>%
  rename(Time = times_used)
```


```{r}
#  Load new beta dataset
df_betas <-read_excel("Data2Regress_betas_FCz_Simple_Error_Model_CorrectTrials_Stimlock_250722.xlsx") #Simple Model 
# Make sure factor levels match
df_betas$Subject     <- as.factor(df_betas$Subject)
df_betas$Stimulation <- factor(df_betas$Stimulation,
                                levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                                labels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC"))


# Match betas to N2 time windows 
df_betas_N2 <- df_betas %>%
  inner_join(df_times_long, by = c("Subject", "Stimulation", "Time"))

# ── Average betas within each subject's N2 window ────────────────────────────
df_betas_summary <- df_betas_N2 %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation, peak_time) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Beta      = mean(Betas, na.rm = TRUE),
    times_used     = list(sort(unique(Time))),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(df_betas_summary)
```

```{r}
df_betas_summary$Stimulation <- relevel(df_betas_summary$Stimulation,"aMCC")


ggplot(df_betas_summary, aes(x = Stimulation, y = Mean_Beta, fill = Stimulation)) +

```


# Run Bayes repeated-measures ANOVA on N2 peaks Congruence

```{r}
df_betas_summary$Stimulation <- relevel(df_betas_summary$Stimulation,"SHAM")
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.1, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", coef = "StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", coef = "StimulationPCC"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd"),   
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sigma")
)

# Fit Bayesian repeated measures model
# Equivalent to repeated measures ANOVA:
# N2 ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject)

fit_brm <- brm(
  #formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject),
  formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation + (1 +Stimulation|| Subject),
  data      = df_betas_summary,
 # prior     = priors,
  #sample_prior = "only",
  chains    = 4,
  iter      = 6000,
  warmup    = 2000,
  cores     = 4,
  seed      = 42,
  control   = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)  # increase if divergences occur
)
save(fit_brm, file = "Bayes_model_EEGbetas_N2_longmodel_Acc_260508.RData")
load("Bayes_model_EEGbetas_N2_longmodel_Acc_260508.RData")

# Model summary
summary(fit_brm)

# Posterior distributions for fixed effects
plot(fit_brm, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)
```


```{r}
posterior <- as_draws_df(fit_brm)

mcmc_areas(posterior,prob = 0.95,
           pars = c("b_StimulationaMCC","b_StimulationPCC")
                  
)+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```



```{r}
#Plot results
emm_n2 <- emmeans(fit_brm, ~ Stimulation, re_formula = NA)
pairs(emm_n2, adjust = "holm")
contrast_draws <- contrast(emm_n2, method = "pairwise") %>% 
  gather_emmeans_draws()

ggplot(contrast_draws, aes(x = .value, y = contrast)) +
  stat_halfeye() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior Difference",
    y = "",
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Contrasts"
  )+theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 18)
  )
```

# Run Bayes repeated-measures ANOVA on N2 peaks for RT

```{r}
df_betas_summary$Stimulation <- relevel(df_betas_summary$Stimulation,"SHAM")
#baseline values: Mean = −0.3; SD = 1.3
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.1, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", coef = "StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", coef = "StimulationPCC"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd"),   
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sigma")
)

# Fit Bayesian repeated measures model
# Equivalent to repeated measures ANOVA:
# N2 ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject)

fit_brm <- brm(
  formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject),
  data      = df_betas_summary,
  prior     = priors,
  chains    = 4,
  iter      = 6000,
  warmup    = 2000,
  cores     = 4,
  seed      = 42,
  control   = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)  # increase if divergences occur
)

# Model summary 
summary(fit_brm)

# Posterior distributions for fixed effects
plot(fit_brm, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)


```

```{r}
#Plot results
emm_n2 <- emmeans(fit_brm, ~ Stimulation, re_formula = NA)
pairs(emm_n2, adjust = "holm")
contrast_draws <- contrast(emm_n2, method = "pairwise") %>% 
  gather_emmeans_draws()

ggplot(contrast_draws, aes(x = .value, y = contrast)) +
  stat_halfeye() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior Difference",
    y = "",
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Contrasts"
  )
```


#Load & clean 
```{r load-betas}
df_betas_raw <- read_excel(
  "Data2Regress_betas_FCz_Simple_Error_Model_CorrectTrials_Stimlock_BlockLevel_3stages_Cong_260511.xlsx"
)

df_betas <- df_betas_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: European decimal commas → numeric (e.g. "-3,3972" → -3.3972)
    Betas       = if (is.character(Betas)) as.numeric(str_replace(Betas, ",", "."))
                  else as.numeric(Betas),
    Subject     = as.factor(Subject),
    Stimulation = as.factor(Stimulation),
    Block       = factor(Block,
                         levels = c(1, 5, 9),
                         labels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late")),
    Time        = as.numeric(Time)
  )

n_na <- sum(is.na(df_betas$Betas))
if (n_na > 0) warning(sprintf("%d NA(s) in Betas after conversion.", n_na))
```

#Filter to 350–450 ms window 
```{r filter-window}
df_window <- df_betas %>%
  filter(Time >= 350, Time <= 450)

message(sprintf("Time points kept: %s", paste(sort(unique(df_window$Time)), collapse = ", ")))
message(sprintf("Rows after filter: %d", nrow(df_window)))
```

#  Average betas per Subject × Block × Stimulation
```{r summarise-subject}
df_subject <- df_window %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation, Block) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Beta = mean(Betas, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

print(df_subject)
```

# Group mean ± SE for the main line 
```{r summarise-group}
df_group <- df_subject %>%
  group_by(Stimulation, Block) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Mean = mean(Mean_Beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE         = sd(Mean_Beta,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

print(df_group)
```

```{r}
stim_colors <- c("verum" = "#CC79A7", "sham" = "#E69F00", "active" = "#56B4E9")
ggplot(df_group, aes(x = Block, y = Grand_Mean, color = Stimulation, group = Stimulation)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Grand_Mean - SE, ymax = Grand_Mean + SE, fill = Stimulation),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = stim_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = stim_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "N2 Betas (350–450 ms) by Block and Stimulation Condition",
    subtitle = "Mean ± SE across subjects",
    x = "Block", y = "Mean Beta Estimates", color = "Stimulation", fill = "Stimulation"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey45")
  )
```
```{r}
df_subject$Stimulation <- relevel(df_subject$Stimulation,"sham")

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.1, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "Stimulationverum"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "Stimulationactive"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd"),   
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sigma")
)

# ── Fit Bayesian repeated measures model ──────────────────────────────────────
# Equivalent to repeated measures ANOVA:
# N2 ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject)

fit_brm <- brm(
  formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation*Block + (1 +Stimulation*Block|| Subject),
  data      = df_subject,
  prior     = priors,
  #sample_prior = "only",
  chains    = 4,
  iter      = 6000,
  warmup    = 2000,
  cores     = 4,
  seed      = 42,
  control   = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)  # increase if divergences occur
)
#save(fit_brm, file = "Bayes_model_EEGbetas_N2_longmodel_Cong_260508.RData")
# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(fit_brm)

# Posterior distributions for fixed effects
plot(fit_brm, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)
```
